title: Blue Razz Ice Geek Bar Pulse X 25000
description:
Blue Razz Ice Geek Bar Pulse X 25000
Bold Flavor Meets Exceptional Convenience
The Blue Razz Ice Geek Bar Pulse X 25000 is here to revolutionize your vaping experience. With a vibrant and refreshing burst of bold blue raspberry flavor paired with an icy, invigorating finish, every puff delivers a perfectly satisfying taste that keeps you coming back for more.
Effortless Vaping
Designed with simplicity in mind, the Geek Bar Pulse X 25000 is a disposable vaping device that combines top-tier performance with hassle-free convenience. Forget about refills and maintenance. Simply unbox, enjoy, and dispose when done.
Sleek Design, Big Flavor
Though compact and portable, this vape doesn’t compromise on taste. Its innovative design ensures consistent flavor delivery from the first inhale to the last, so you never have to miss out on the full experience.
Key Features
Puff Count
:
Up to 25,000 (Regular Mode) or 15,000 (Pulse Mode)
E-liquid
:
18mL, 5% nicotine
Battery
:
820mAh rechargeable (USB-C)
Display
:
Smart 3D Curved LED Screen
Coils
:
Dual Mesh for superior flavor
Modes
:
Soft, Normal, Pulse
Airflow
:
Adjustable for customized draw
Perfect For On-The-Go
Whether you’re at a party, relaxing at home, or on a busy day out, the Geek Bar Pulse X 25000 is your trusty companion for smooth, flavorful vaping anywhere life takes you.
Reimagine what vaping can be with the Blue Razz Ice Geek Bar Pulse X 25000. Smooth, delicious, and designed just for you.
